//: Single source for MCP servers. Run shared/render-mcp.py after editing; it rewrites the generated block in configs/opencode/files/opencode.jsonc and configs/claude/files/mcp.json. Fields: command (stdio argv) | url (remote); bearer = env var holding an Authorization Bearer token; env = {VAR: VAR} passed through; only = [opencode|claude] to restrict targets; comment = rendered above the opencode entry.

alphaxiv.comment: arXiv paper search/reading, PDF Q&A, researcher lookup. OAuth 2.1: sign in via /mcps (OpenCode) or /mcp (Claude Code) on first use.

huggingface.comment: HuggingFace models/datasets/spaces search, model cards, HF daily papers. Bearer HF_TOKEN, persisted for the daemon from the hf CLI, not from ~/.env. Header auth avoids anonymous rate limits. Claude Code gets this as a claude.ai connector.

github.comment: GitHub repos/issues/PRs. Fine-grained PAT in GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, GitHub's documented remote pattern. Do NOT use GITHUB_TOKEN (the gh CLI gho_ token): unsupported, expires, and a documented 401 cause.

exa.comment: Exa semantic web search for trend signals (blogs, launches, X threads). EXA_API_KEY is static in ~/.env. Claude Code gets this as a claude.ai connector.
